title: 오늘 뭘 먹어요? 뭘 사요? — 을/를
objective: By the end, you can choose 을 or 를 based on the last sound of a noun, use the short spoken form ㄹ (뭘, 이걸), and put the particle on the object in simple everyday sentences.
summary: Learn to use the object particle 을/를 (spoken short form ㄹ) to show what you eat, buy, watch, or do.

task.title: USE 을, 를, AND ㄹ
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write, or fix the object particle so the sentence is correct.

forms.when: The noun ends in a consonant (it has a final consonant, 받침).
forms.means: Marks the object: the thing that the action is done to.
forms.exampleMeaning: I eat bread in the morning.

forms.when: The noun ends in a vowel (no final consonant).
forms.means: Same meaning as 을. Only the shape changes.
forms.exampleMeaning: I meet a friend on the weekend.

forms.when: In casual speech, after a vowel. 를 becomes ㄹ and joins the noun: 무엇을 → 뭐를 → 뭘, 이거를 → 이걸.
forms.means: Same meaning as 을/를. It is shorter, and you hear it a lot in speech.
forms.exampleMeaning: What are you having for lunch?

watchOut: 물를 (X) → 물을 (O): ㄹ is a final consonant too, so use 을.
커피가 좋아해요 (X) → 커피를 좋아해요 (O): 좋아하다 (to like) takes 을/를. (커피가 좋아요 is also correct.)
시간을 있어요 (X) → 시간이 있어요 (O): 있다 and 없다 do not take 을/를. Use 이/가.
exercises: ①저는 아침에 신문(을/를) 읽어요. / ②동생이 우유(을/를) 마셔요. / ③시장에서 귤(을/를) 사요.
①지금 돈(이/을) 없어요. / ②은행에서 돈(이/을) 찾아요.
answers: ① 을 (신문을) ② 를 (우유를) ③ 을 (귤을)
저는 한국 노래를 좋아해요. (노래가 → 노래를) (Changing the verb instead is also correct: 저는 한국 노래가 좋아요.)
저는 방을 청소해요. (The key part is 방을. 제가 방을 청소해요, 저는 방을 청소합니다, and 저는 방을 청소했어요 are also correct.)
① 이 (돈이 없어요) ② 을 (돈을 찾아요)
